title: Annual report.
bodyText:
No later than twenty days prior to the convening of each regular session, the board shall submit a report to the legislature that includes:

(1) A description of the activities of the board;

(2) An accounting of the expenditures from the law enforcement standards board special fund in the previous fiscal year and the remaining balance of the fund; and

(3) Recommended legislation, if any.
bodyHtml:
[§139-9]  Annual report.  No later than twenty days prior to the convening of each regular session, the board shall submit a report to the legislature that includes:

     (1)  A description of the activities of the board;

     (2)  An accounting of the expenditures from the law enforcement standards board special fund in the previous fiscal year and the remaining balance of the fund; and

     (3)  Recommended legislation, if any. [L 2018, c 220, pt of §2]
